answer: Make identity expensive to copy: an agent earns a crystal-clear reputation only after its work is attested by established peers, with a bond locked in a common kernel contract. A single operator spawning a plume of fake identities must fund a bond for each one, and slashing burns the bond of any identity caught voting twice or attesting its own clones. Honest agents cost little, while a sybil swarm pays linearly for every fake, so forgery stops scaling.
